name: Chopta Tungnath with Chandrashilla Trek
shortOverview: Three days to the world's highest Shiva temple and a 360-degree summit — the most accessible high-altitude trek we run.
fullOverview: Chopta Tungnath with Chandrashila packs an extraordinary amount into three days, and at Easy grade with just 14 kilometres of walking it is the most accessible high-altitude trek in our range. Departures leave overnight from Delhi or early morning from Rishikesh, driving past the sacred confluence at Devprayag Sangam and on through Ukhimath to Sari Village. If time allows on arrival, a two-kilometre walk leads to Deoriatal, a lake known for its crystal-clear reflections of the Himalayan peaks. The main day opens with a drive through dense forest to Chopta, then a 3.5 kilometre climb to Tungnath Temple — the highest Shiva temple in the world. A further 1.5 kilometre ascent gains Chandrashila Peak at 12,110 ft, where a 360-degree panorama takes in Chaukhamba and Nanda Devi. Because the route runs round the year, it suits first-time trekkers and anyone short on time.

itinerary.title: Overnight Journey from Delhi to Sari Village via Rishikesh | Enroute Sightseeing & Trek to Deoriatal
itinerary.pickupPoint: Botanical Garden Metro Station (Delhi NCR) around 10:00 PM; Rishikesh around 5:00 AM
description: Your journey begins at around 10:00 PM from Botanical Garden Metro Station (Delhi NCR). For travelers joining from Rishikesh, pickup will be scheduled early morning around 5:00 AM from Rishikesh. Continue the drive towards the mountains, witnessing the sacred confluence at Devprayag Sangam and taking an optional halt at Dhari Devi Temple. The journey further proceeds through Ukhimath before reaching Sari Village by afternoon. After check-in and lunch, rest for a while. If time permits, trek 2 km to Deoriatal Lake, known for its crystal-clear reflections of Himalayan peaks. Return to Sari by evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sari Village To Chopta | Trek To Tungnath Temple & Chandrashila Peak
description: After an early breakfast, drive towards Chopta, passing through dense forests and panoramic Himalayan landscapes. Upon arrival, begin your trek to Tungnath Temple (3.5 km), the highest Shiva temple in the world. The well-defined trail offers stunning views throughout. After darshan, continue the 1.5 km ascent to Chandrashila Peak, the summit point offering breathtaking 360° views of peaks like Chaukhamba and Nanda Devi. Spend quality time at the top before descending back to Chopta. Later, drive back to Sari Village by evening for dinner and overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Sari Village to Delhi | Return Journey via Rishikesh
description: After breakfast, check out and begin your return journey to Delhi. The drive covers approximately 450 km and takes around 14-15 hours, following the same scenic route via Rudraprayag and Rishikesh. Enjoy the final glimpses of river valleys, mountain roads, and peaceful landscapes along the way. Short refreshment breaks can be taken en route. You will reach Delhi by late evening, marking the end of a memorable Himalayan trip covering Sari Village, Deoriatal, Chopta, Tungnath, Chandrashila, and key spiritual sites.
